_doc: Servers matching a rule here are RESTRICTED: only members of allowed_groups / the emails in allowed_users are deployed, regardless of label/group wiring in the UI. When allowed_users is set, only those users may manage agent access to matching servers (admins are NOT exempt). Changing this file requires a git commit, so widening access to a restricted server is always traceable. See src/restricted.js for the format.

unprivileged_servers._why: nemo holds every colleague's agent container and secrets: no superkey account may administer it. Logins land in the caller's own nemo instance via /usr/local/sbin/nemo-enter (installed on the host by hand). Admin = root key on the host only.
